what_it_is: Iridescent and holographic glitter is a polyester-based decorative material that refracts light to produce a colourful, sparkling effect on craft projects.
how_to_use: This glitter is cut from a thin polyester film, offering higher coverage compared to standard PVC glitter and superior resistance to UV light, heat, and solvents. To use, simply sprinkle or apply with adhesive onto your chosen surface for vibrant, light-catching effects in jewelry, modelmaking, trinkets, or cosplay pieces. Choose the fine 0.015" (approx. 0.4mm) hex jewel size for subtle shine, or the larger 0.125" (approx. 3.2mm) hex for bold, noticeable sparkle.
also_available: Very fine 0.015" hex (approx. 0.4mm), Iridescent, 125g bag | Large 0.125" hex (approx. 3.2mm), Holographic, 125g bag
faq_json: [["Is this glitter suitable for outdoor use?", "Yes, the polyester base offers good UV and weather resistance for outdoor crafts."], ["Can I mix both sizes for extra texture?", "Absolutely—mixing fine and large glitter adds depth and variety to your designs.  Best for: Smallscale crafters working on cosplay, jewelry, trinket boxes, hat embellishments, or miniature dioramas who want long-lasting, vibrant sparkle."]]
coverage_sentence: This glitter is cut from a thin polyester film, offering higher coverage compared to standard PVC glitter and superior resistance to UV light, heat, and solvents.

title: Kobra Spray Paints
tags: Kobra Spray Paints; Paint; Paints Pigments and Special Finishes; Spray Paints
what_it_is: Kobra Spray Paint is a fast-covering, high-opacity aerosol paint designed for use on a wide variety of surfaces such as canvas, wood, metal, glass, paper, card, plastic, concrete, and brick.
how_to_use: The paint features a newly formulated high "solid" content for rapid, even coverage, delivering a crisp matte finish with a subtle sheen. It comes with a Fat spray pattern nozzle for maximal coverage and can be used for both fine detail and broad area work; spare nozzles in other styles can be purchased separately to tailor the spray to your project needs. Shake the can thoroughly, spray at a consistent distance from your surface, and always use in a well-ventilated area for optimal results.
faq_json: [["Can Kobra Spray Paint be used on plastic and glass?", "Yes, it is formulated for reliable adhesion on plastic, glass, and a range of other surfaces."], ["Does it dry completely matte?", "The finish is a matte with a slight sheen; for a completely flat look, consider using decoration sprays.  Best for: Smallscale craft projects, cosplay props, modelmaking, and detail work where control and coverage matter most."]]
coverage_sentence: The paint features a newly formulated high "solid" content for rapid, even coverage, delivering a crisp matte finish with a subtle sheen.
safety_sentence: Shake the can thoroughly, spray at a consistent distance from your surface, and always use in a well-ventilated area for optimal results.

title: Plasticine
tags: Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Clay; Modelling Clay; Modelmaking; Plasticine; Sculpting
what_it_is: Plasticine is a reusable, non-toxic modelling medium designed for easy shaping and creative projects.
how_to_use: It stays pliable without drying out, allowing you to sculpt, mould, and reshape figures or components as many times as you like. Plasticine is suitable for hands of all ages, perfect for modelling detailed shapes, miniature sculptures, cosplay props, or jewellery bases. Simply knead the material until soft, then shape using your hands or basic sculpting tools; once finished, store it airtight to maintain its softness for your next project.
also_available: White | Black | Blue | Red | Green | Yellow | Brown | Grey | Assorted Colour Packs
faq_json: [["Does Plasticine harden or dry out?", "It remains soft and malleable indefinitely when sealed tightly and with proper storage, if not stored properly it may dry out."], ["Is Plasticine safe for children?", "Yes, it is non-toxic and suitable for supervised use by children.  Best for: Home crafters, cosplayers, jewellery artists, and modelmakers looking for an endlessly reusable sculpting material."]]
safety_sentence: Plasticine is a reusable, non-toxic modelling medium designed for easy shaping and creative projects.

title: 2 Part Black Gun Foam
tags: Black Materials; Casting; Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Expanding Foam; Foam; Soft Casting Materials
what_it_is: Black Gun Foam is a two-part polyurethane, semi-flexible foam used to create lightweight, realistic props that mimic the appearance and texture of steel or weaponry.
how_to_use: This foam features a thick, semi-gloss black skin after curing, which eliminates the need for extensive finishing and hides minor damage thanks to pigment dispersed throughout. To use, mix the two components at a 3:1 ratio, pour into your mold at around 20°C, and allow 20 minutes before demolding; full cure completes in 12 hours. Ideal for casting prop shapes, cosplay accessories, or decorative elements where authentic look and lightweight construction are key.

Best for: Makers crafting cosplay weapons, jewelry displays, modelmaking projects, or decorative pieces that look tough but stay light as a feather."]]

title: Jesmonite Super Plasticiser
tags: Casting; Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Jesmonite; Jesmonite Additives
what_it_is: Super Plasticiser is an additive designed to improve the flow and workability of casting mixes without adding extra liquid base or water.
how_to_use: This product is designed for use with AC730 and AC930, which are both dry mixes that benefit from enhanced flow without compromising the final set. Simply add 8–12 grams per kilogram of your casting mix to achieve a smoother, easier-to-pour consistency—just don't exceed the recommended dose or your mix may separate. Great for achieving intricate detail in moulds, especially where hand-mixing alone can't provide enough mobility.
also_available: 250g bottle | 1kg bottle
faq_json: [["Can I use Super Plasticiser with other Jesmonite products?", "It’s designed specifically for AC730 and AC930, so always check with your product instructions first."], ["What happens if I add too much?", "Overdosing may cause your mix to separate and compromise the final result.  Best for: Home casting, intricate jewellery, cosplay accessories, modelmaking, and detailed craft pours where mix flow is essential."]]

title: Jesmonite Decorative Paint
tags: Casting; Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Jesmonite; Jesmonite Paints; Paint
what_it_is: Jesmonite Decorative Paints are sol-silicate based paints designed to create shimmering metallic finishes on Jesmonite surfaces.
how_to_use: These paints can be applied neat for bold, even coverage, or mixed with a dilution agent (available separately) to produce washes or translucent effects. They apply best with a sponge, gently dabbed onto the surface, and once dry, provide a durable, water-repellent, UV-stable, and lightfast finish suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Cleanup is simple with soap and water. Use sparingly, as a little covers a lot.
also_available: Midnight Silver | Lava Red | Golden Honey | Burnt Orange
faq_json: [["Can these paints be used on materials other than Jesmonite?", "They’re formulated for Jesmonite but may adhere to other mineral surfaces; test first for best results."], ["Do I need a primer before painting?", "For most Jesmonite surfaces, no primer is needed, but ensure the surface is clean and dry.  Best for: Smallscale crafters, home jewelry makers, trinket creators, cosplay accents, and modelmakers seeking durable metallic finishes."]]
coverage_sentence: These paints can be applied neat for bold, even coverage, or mixed with a dilution agent (available separately) to produce washes or translucent effects.

title: EVA Foam
tags: Black Materials; Materials and Thermoplastics; Sheet Material; Thermoplastic Sheet Materials; Thermoplastics
what_it_is: EVA Foam Sheet is a versatile crafting material that can be cut, glued, heat shaped, or carved for detailed builds and creative projects.
how_to_use: This medium-density foam provides a flexible yet sturdy base for constructing props, costume pieces, jewelry displays, or scale models. The surface can be refined with fillers and painted as needed, while the sheet’s flexibility makes it suitable for layering or shaping into complex forms. To use, cut or carve the foam to shape, use heat for bending, then adhere pieces together with suitable glue; surface gaps or seams can be finished with compatible fillers - check out FlexiFiller.

faq_json: [["Can the foam be painted after shaping?", "Yes, it can be primed and painted once cut and formed."], ["Is it easy to glue pieces together?", "Yes, most contact adhesives or hot glue work well with EVA foam. title: ZA22 Skin Safe Silicone
tags: Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Mouldmaking; Silicone
what_it_is: ZA22 Skin Safe Silicone is a two-part, addition cure silicone designed for direct application onto skin to create reusable, flexible moulds.
how_to_use: With a texture similar to soft butter, it adheres to vertical and contoured surfaces without dripping, making it ideal for detailed life casting projects. Simply mix the pink base and white catalyst in a 1:1 ratio by weight until fully blended, then apply directly to the desired area—no barrier necessary, but do be careful around small hairs and maybe use a little moisturiser. It sets to a pink, flexible form in about 15–20 minutes and works with a range of casting materials including polyester, epoxy, and polyurethane resins, as well as plaster, concrete, and Jesmonite.
also_available: 2kg pack | 6kg pack
specifications: Cured colour: Pink | Pot life: 6 minutes | Cure time: 15–20 minutes | Shore A hardness: 22 | Working viscosity: over 50,000 cP
faq_json: [["Can I use ZA22 on sensitive areas or the face?", "Yes, it is skin safe, but be cautious with small hair or protect with moisturiser for easy removal."], ["How do I know the silicone is fully mixed?", "When the blend is a uniform colour with no pink or white streaks, it is ready to use.  Best for: Lifecasting, cosplay prosthetics, small jewelry moulds, and creative projects needing repeated high-detail impressions."]]
mix_ratio_sentence: Simply mix the pink base and white catalyst in a 1:1 ratio by weight until fully blended, then apply directly to the desired area—no barrier necessary, but do be careful around small hairs and maybe use a little moisturiser.

title: Pigments for Silicone
tags: Mouldmaking; Paints Pigments and Special Finishes; Pigment; Silicone; Silicone Pigments
what_it_is: Silicone pigments are concentrated colour additives specifically designed to be mixed with addition- and condensation-cured silicone for customisable casting and mould-making results.
how_to_use: These pigments make it easy to colour code complex moulds or props, and you can brush layers in different colours to track even coverage during application. Colours can be intermixed for unique shades, but avoid using more than 5% pigment by total silicone weight to ensure proper curing. Just add the pigment into your silicone, mix thoroughly, and apply as needed.

Best for: Crafting, cosplay, jewellery, and modelmaking projects needing bespoke coloured silicone molding or casting."]]
coverage_sentence: These pigments make it easy to colour code complex moulds or props, and you can brush layers in different colours to track even coverage during application.

title: Plaster Retarder
tags: Accelorator; Casting; Casting Mouldmaking and Sculpting Materials; Control Agents; Plaster; Retarder
what_it_is: Plaster control agents are additives designed to either accelerate or retard the setting time of plaster, giving crafters more control over their working pace.
how_to_use:
Retarder:
Dissolve 100g of retarder powder in 1 litre of water. Cool. Use 5ml of this mix per 1 litre of water to be mixed with plaster, and it will approximately double the setting time.
also_available: Accelerator (reduces setting time; powder form) | Retarder (extends setting time; liquid concentrate)
faq_json: [["How much control agent should I add for my project?", "Start with the recommended guideline, test with a small batch, and adjust as needed since effectiveness varies by plaster type."], ["Can I use both accelerator and retarder together?", "It’s not recommended, as their effects can counteract and complicate results.  Best for: Hobbyists, modelmakers, prop builders, and crafters who need flexibility in plaster setting times for detailed or time-sensitive projects."]]

title: Ambidextorous Scissors
tags: Cutting; Propmaking Tools; Scissors; Tools; Tools Brushes and Sundries
what_it_is: Ambidextrous scissors are cutting tools designed with symmetrical, ergonomic handles for comfortable use in either the left or right hand.
how_to_use: These scissors eliminate the inconvenience often experienced by left-handed crafters, offering a balanced grip and precise cutting action regardless of which hand you use. Suitable for paper, fabric, and lightweight materials, simply grip the handles in your preferred hand and cut as usual—no awkward twisting or uneven pressure required.
faq_json: [["Are these scissors suitable for both left-handed and right-handed users?", "Yes, the design supports comfortable and efficient cutting for either hand."], ["Can I use these scissors for fabric as well as paper?", "Yes, they're ideal for both paper and lightweight fabrics commonly used in craft projects.  Best for: Smallscale craft, cosplay, modelmaking, and any project where comfort for all users matters."]]

what_it_is: Dirty Down Snot & Gore is a specialist product designed to create realistic, gory, or slimy looking effects for modelmaking, cosplay, and crafts.
how_to_use: This product is easily applied with a toothpick to simulate streaks of snot or blood, making it a favourite for adding gross-out or horror details to miniatures, jewelry, costume props, or themed craft projects. title: Paper Rope
tags: Materials; Materials and Thermoplastics; Paper; Paper Rope; Propmaking; Rope; Set Dressing
what_it_is: Paper Rope is a strong, flexible crafting material used for structure-building, adding texture, and forming shapes in a variety of creative projects.
how_to_use: It is typically used as a former for glass fibre laminations to create stiffening ribs, but it’s equally handy for building curved mouldings, bulking out trees and branches in modelmaking, or providing decorative relief to surfaces. To use, shape or bend it as needed, secure in place, and finish with resins or surface coatings for texture or flame retardancy. Paper Rope can be finished or painted as needed, making it ideal for custom projects.
